messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API p99 latency > 6s for the past 3m, queue depth growing. Auto-escalating to #incidents :rotating_light:

maya-oncall: on it, paging now. seeing 10k queued requests in the hosted API shard for us-west-2. p95 -> 1.8s, p99 -> 6.3s.

josh-sre: confirming from metrics: request_queue_length{env=hosted,region=us-west-2} jumped from ~2k -> 10k at 18:02 UTC.

priya-pd: any customer 5xx spikes?

maya-oncall: some 504s reported in logs for long-poll endpoints, mostly from high-token generation requests.

aaron-sre: looking at autoscaler events. cloud-provider API returning 429s when attempting to request GPUs. suspect we're hitting provider account quota or a transient rate-limit.

deploy-bot: autoscaler.log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T18:03:12Z ERROR: CreateInstance failed, status=429, body={"error":"quotaExceeded","message":"Exceeded GPU quota for project"}
2026-03-15T18:03:13Z WARN: Retry attempt 3/5
2026-03-15T18:03:14Z ERROR: scaleUp aborted: maxRetriesReached
```

maya-oncall: so autoscaler is trying to grow but cloud refuses. current pool capacity 96 GPUs, configured maxReplicas=120, target would need ~130 -> breach.

zoe-ops: are there any idle Dedicated pools we can borrow?

josh-sre: Dedicated pools are tenant-isolated; cross-tenant borrow is not allowed without contract. however we do have a small emergency burst pool in us-west-2 reserved for infra but it's at 0 right now (turned off to save costs).

priya-pd: customer impact assessment: which customers are affected? any enterprise SLA hits?

maya-oncall: initial scan: high-traffic API keys tied to a few PLG customers and internal e2e test jobs. We'll need to identify top offenders and throttle.

aaron-sre: running top-keys by QPS...

aaron-sre: top keys (by queued requests):
```
- key: prod-client-42 -> 36% of queued
- key: prod-client-77 -> 18% of queued
- key: internal-eval -> 12% of queued
- others -> 34%
```

maya-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) enable global emergency rate-limit (drop to 60% of normal) 2) kill background internal-eval jobs 3) attempt to restart autoscaler and backoff then try alternate region routing.

josh-sre: implementing 1 & 2 now. applying global limiter:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/limits \
  -d '{"scope":"hosted-global","qps":0.6}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BOTPAT'
```

deploy-bot: rate-limit applied, response: 200 OK.

maya-oncall: canceling internal-eval batch jobs (job-controller):
```
kubectl -n infra delete job internal-eval-2026-03-15 --grace-period=10
```

aaron-sre: internal-eval accounted for ~12% backlog, evicted. queue dropped ~1.2k.

priya-pd: that's good but still big. what's the status of autoscaler after restart?

josh-sre: restarting autoscaler service to force different cloud region selection algorithm.

deploy-bot: autoscaler restart logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:01Z INFO: restarting autoscaler
2026-03-15T18:12:10Z INFO: reconcile loop started
2026-03-15T18:12:15Z ERROR: CreateInstance failed, status=429, body={"error":"quotaExceeded"}
2026-03-15T18:12:42Z INFO: trying fallback region: us-west-1
```

maya-oncall: fallback region attempts are in-flight but latency to us-west-1 is higher for many customers; we should avoid surprise customer impact.

zoe-ops: can we temporarily route traffic for the top offending keys to hosted-non-prod (lower-cost) or dedicated slots?

josh-sre: can re-route non-SLA keys. prod-client-42 is a PLG customer (no enterprise SLA), we can apply a per-key throttle and show them a 503 with Retry-After.

maya-oncall: applying per-key throttle for prod-client-42 and prod-client-77 now. script:
```
PATCH /tokens/prod-client-42/config {"max_concurrency": 2, "drop_policy": "503"}
```

deploy-bot: throttle applied for prod-client-42 and prod-client-77. queued requests for those keys dropped significantly. overall queue dropped to ~6.3k.

priya-pd: notify customers? We should send targeted messages to the top-affected non-enterprise customers via the in-app banner and email. For enterprise customers, we need to check if any requests timed out; we might have SLA exposure.

maya-oncall: checking logs for enterprise keys... nothing alarming for gold-tier customers — most impacted are PLG free-tier or internal.

aaron-sre: p99 has improved from 6.3s -> 3.1s after throttles. still above normal but manageable.

zoe-ops: next steps to restore capacity: 1) escalate quota with cloud provider (will take hours) 2) attempt redistribution to us-west-1 (ongoing) 3) request temporary increase from partner account (ops) 4) enable conservative batch-quantization to reduce GPU memory and increase throughput.

josh-sre: starting conservative quantization rollout for smaller models to free up VRAM. patch command:
```
PATCH /runtime/config {"quant_profile":"conservative-16bit","apply_to":"small-gen-models"}
```

deploy-bot: quantization job started, rollout progressing. expected reduction in per-instance memory ~18-22% after model reload.

priya-pd: we should create a status page update: partial degraded service for hosted API in us-west-2, mitigation in progress.

statuspage-bot: Status page draft created: title="Partial service degradation: Hosted API (us-west-2)". Will publish after approval.

maya-oncall: handoff note for next on-call at 18:30 UTC: we have queue length ~4.8k, p99 ~2.9s, autoscaler unable to add GPUs due to cloud quota. Mitigations in place: global rate limiting, per-key throttles for top offenders, internal job cancellations, quantization rollout, fallback region attempts ongoing. No enterprise SLA breached detected so far.

aaron-sre: leaving next action items in incident board:
- follow up with cloud provider quota escalation (ticket #CLOUD-9921)
- monitor fallback-region replication and traffic routing
- validate quantization memory savings and model reload stability
- prepare rollback plan for rate limits and per-key throttles

maya-oncall: handing pager to josh-sre at 18:30 UTC. tagging @josh-sre.

josh-sre: acknowledged, taking over. will monitor autoscaler and queue for next 2 hours.

priya-pd: will prepare customer comms for affected PLG customers and standby message for enterprise if any SLA breaches detected.

zoe-ops: created incident ticket INC-2026-0315 in JIRA with summary "Hosted API queue growth due to GPU quota/exhaustion in us-west-2" and linked this thread.

maya-oncall: closing immediate pager. leaving thread open for post-mortem notes and timeline. :white_check_mark:

josh-sre: monitoring shows steady decline to ~2k queue after quantization and continued throttles. will keep on-call updates in this thread.

statuspage-bot: Published: Partial service degradation — Hosted API us-west-2. Message: "We are experiencing elevated latency and request queueing in us-west-2 due to capacity provisioning issues. Mitigations in progress."
